risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial dated, quantified disclosure on COVID-19 impacts, regulatory restrictions, hotel demand recovery, and SBA loan forgiveness. Risk remains elevated from dependence on volatile travel and group demand, while optimistic recovery statements and limited quantification of forward-looking liquidity or operating risks temper transparency. Critical accounting language is largely standard boilerplate and emphasizes estimation uncertainty without detailing sensitivity impacts.
